# j2k-auto

> A Gradle plugin that generates Kotlin data classes from sample JSON files at build time.

## Details
j2k-auto eliminates DTO boilerplate by inferring idiomatic Kotlin models directly from JSON samples. It handles nested objects, arrays, nullability, and name mapping (snake_case to camelCase) automatically.

## Key Features
- **Inference Engine**: Lattice-based type merging for robust model generation.
- **Annotation Styles**: Supports kotlinx.serialization, Moshi, and Gson.
- **Gradle Integration**: Hilt/KSP-style generation, configuration-cache safe.
- **Advanced Shaping**: Automatic subpackage mirroring and configurable visibility.

## Technical Context
The plugin uses KotlinPoet for code generation and a custom schema inference engine. It operates during the Gradle build lifecycle, ensuring models are always in sync with JSON samples.
